text: Art museums are among the largest buildings globally, and many of the world's most prominent institutions have undertaken expansion initiatives over time to increase their total exhibition space.[1] The following list ranks art museums based on their gallery space, as reported by credible sources, including only those with more than 10,000 square meters (110,000 sq ft) of gallery space. Additionally, another list includes art museums expected to provide at least 10,000 square meters (110,000 sq ft) of gallery space in the future, either through ongoing construction, expansion, or renovation.
